ticket: tickets.md ticket 14 (Hand-lift MSCA Tier 3 from the vault) - post-review correction
supersession_note: The superseded record is NOT rewritten. It remains the dated, accurate record of what was decided at hand-lift time. This entry records the subsequent correction (CLAUDE.md §9.4).
decision: The ticket-14 fifth validation status 'Refuted' is withdrawn. ELTE's disposition is expressed as validation_status 'Unresolved' plus two descriptive fields: source_disposition 'absent_from_sources' and do_not_invent true. No fifth status value is introduced anywhere.
reason: Gate hazard (primary). A status outside {confirmed, inferred, assumed, unresolved} bypasses BOTH honesty gates: no_unresolved_material_claims fails only when overall_status == 'unresolved', and W1 (assumed_claims_are_operator_declared) governs only status == 'assumed'. A claim marked 'Refuted' would therefore pass both - reopening, under a different name, exactly the laundering channel W1 was built to close.

Schema hazard. The Tier 5 artifact enum is [confirmed, inferred, assumed, unresolved] (artifact_schema_specification.yaml). A fifth value reaching a claim_status or validation_status is a MALFORMED_ARTIFACT. The canonical-pack deriver (ticket 10) reads Tier 3 and carries provenance upward, and the drafting path carries claim statuses up - these are the leak paths.

Semantics. The vault states ELTE is absent from all sources ('ELTE not mentioned in any source; do not invent a role'). That is absence of evidence, not evidence against. 'Refuted' would wrongly foreclose a legitimate operator confirmation or beta-declaration of ELTE as host, contradicting operator authority (CLAUDE.md §3, priority 1) and D11 (the operator may declare what the engine may not invent).
Governance. Introducing a fifth status value is a de facto change to §12.2's vocabulary effected without an amendment, which §14.1 makes invalid. The descriptive-flag approach requires no amendment.
rule_established: The validation-status vocabulary is CLOSED at the four CLAUDE.md §12.2 categories: Confirmed / Inferred / Assumed / Unresolved. Additional dispositions are carried by descriptive fields (e.g. source_disposition, do_not_invent), never by new status values. Any future need for a fifth status is a §12.2 constitutional amendment requiring explicit human instruction (§14.5), not a local extension.
what_is_preserved: The guard the extension was reaching for is retained in full: the engine must never assert ELTE in any proposal role. It is now carried by do_not_invent: true rather than by a status value, so the guard survives without the gate-bypass, schema, semantic, and governance costs.
